intro.headline: India in 2050: an imagined year, built on today's targets
intro.summary: Everything on these pages is speculation. Where a plan or projection exists today, it is named and sourced; what follows from it is imagined, and no real person or real event is claimed.

technology-science.title: Technology & science
technology-science.standfirst: Today's plans for a space station and a net-zero economy, extended forward as scenarios.

items.title: An Indian space station in orbit (imagined)
items.summary: The Bharatiya Antariksh Station is planned today to weigh about 52 tonnes, orbit near 400 km and be complete by 2035. By 2050 it might have been staffed for years and be due for replacement.

items.title: Routine crewed flights (imagined)
items.summary: Gaganyaan is designed to carry three people to low Earth orbit; by 2050 crewed flights might be unremarkable.

items.title: A grid closer to net zero (imagined)
items.summary: India has said it aims for net-zero emissions by 2070; by 2050 the electricity grid might be well on the way, with coal a smaller share of supply.

items.title: Everyday machine translation (imagined)
items.summary: With dozens of widely spoken languages, a phone that translates speech between them fluently might be an ordinary utility by 2050.

government-politics.title: Government & politics
government-politics.standfirst: Possible futures for a country that has set itself a date.

items.title: After the Viksit Bharat deadline (imagined)
items.summary: The government's Viksit Bharat @2047 framework targets a developed-country economy of about 29-30 trillion US dollars by 2047. By 2050 India would either be judged to have met it or be explaining why not.

items.title: Counting 1.7 billion (imagined)
items.summary: Projections suggest India's population will approach 1.7 billion by 2050, so the census that year, if held, would be the largest administrative exercise ever mounted.

items.title: States and the Union (imagined)
items.summary: Fiscal and linguistic arrangements between the Union and the states might look different by 2050; no one can say which way.

items.title: Public services by default digital (imagined)
items.summary: Most government dealings might be possible without a visit to an office, if identity and payment systems keep spreading.

freedom-history.title: Independence & history
freedom-history.standfirst: Looking back from a hundred and three years of independence.

items.title: The republic's centenary (imagined)
items.summary: The Constitution came into force on 26 January 1950, so 26 January 2050 would be the republic's hundredth anniversary.

items.title: Halfway to the 2070 pledge (imagined)
items.summary: India's net-zero pledge is dated 2070; by 2050 the country would be about midway between the pledge and now.

items.title: Living with heat (imagined)
items.summary: Heatwaves like the one that reached 53 C in 2010 might be more frequent and planned for.

sensitivity.note: A speculative scenario about heat and health.

items.title: Archives of the independence era (imagined)
items.summary: By 2050 almost no one who remembers independence will be alive, so oral-history collections might matter more.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.standfirst: Targets that might, or might not, have been met.

items.title: A completed space station (imagined)
items.summary: Planned for completion by 2035, a finished station might by 2050 be a settled achievement.

items.title: A net-zero path (imagined)
items.summary: By 2050 India might be able to show a falling emissions curve against its 2070 pledge.

items.title: Universal digital literacy (imagined)
items.summary: A generation raised with ubiquitous phones might make basic digital literacy near-universal.

items.title: Hosting an Olympic Games (imagined)
items.summary: India has said it is interested in hosting a summer Olympics; whether it does by 2050 is open.

items.title: A football breakthrough (imagined)
items.summary: A large youth population might lift the national football team in Asian competitions.

items.title: A deep chess bench (imagined)
items.summary: Having produced several grandmasters, India might field several world-class players at once.

items.title: Esports alongside cricket (imagined)
items.summary: Competitive gaming might draw crowds comparable to some traditional sports.

economy-business.title: Economy & business
economy-business.standfirst: Today's targets and projections, not forecasts.

items.title: Projected population
items.summary: Current projections suggest India's population will reach about 1.7 billion by 2050.

items.title: The 2047 economic target
items.summary: The government's stated target is an economy of about 29-30 trillion US dollars by 2047.

items.title: The net-zero year
items.summary: India has announced a target of net-zero emissions by 2070.
